faqs.question: Where can I find my testing room?
faqs.answer: Check your assigned room with your coach. [Map](/map) shows buildings and published room directions; [My rooms](/rooms) provides the available private lookup.

faqs.question: Where are schedule changes posted?
faqs.answer: Check [Live updates](/updates) and the [Schedule](/schedule). Adjusted times are labeled in the schedule. Email subscription controls are on Live updates.
